observation.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do sleep 30; echo "=== iter $i ==="; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 4 fs-watcher 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG" | tail -4; echo "--- watch dir:"; ls -la watch/ | grep -vE "keep"; echo "--- asr recent (non-debug):"; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 30 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG|httpcore|GPUWatchdog|monitor" | tail -10; if ls watch/ | grep -qiE "\.txt$|Transkript|\.vtt$|\.srt$"; then echo "TRANSCRIPT FOUND"; break; fi; done
